description: Portable Studio storage policy defaults. Locations are user choices: accept, relocate, or defer. Nothing here repartitions, formats, or deletes anything.
rules: Project and asset media are never auto-deleted, moved, or scanned for telemetry.
Only cache and scratch entries with a known owner may be proposed for cleanup, always with a preview first.
No filesystem is formatted, repartitioned, or forced to NOCOW by this policy.
Changing a location never moves existing files without an explicit, previewed migration.
